subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should the official iOS app pursue CarPlay support now, and which Apple-approved category/entitlement and driving-safe Talk UX should it use?
rationale: The request is a new native app distribution and safety-sensitive UX surface; automation cannot choose the entitlement path, App Store signing implications, or what assistant actions are allowed while driving.

options.title: Sponsor CarPlay planning
options.body: Treat this as an iOS roadmap item and require entitlement/category research, release-signing proof, and a constrained voice-first UX before implementation.

options.title: Defer behind iOS priorities
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product request but do not start implementation until current iOS stability, setup, and Talk work has a maintainer-owned CarPlay plan.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide OpenClaw should not expose assistant workflows through CarPlay under the current product and safety model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor CarPlay planning
recommendation.body: Treat this as an iOS roadmap item and require entitlement/category research, release-signing proof, and a constrained voice-first UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue was explicitly routed to this iOS app contact, and recent iOS companion-app UI/navigation history makes them the best available decision owner from the current evidence.
